title: Local Thickness Exploitation on 36-Layer Ta2O5/SiO2 Dual-Band Stop Filter
scientific_hypothesis: Narrowing thickness perturbation bounds to ±8 nm around an established high-performing candidate will allow the optimizer to resolve finer Fabry-Pérot interference features without disrupting established phase relationships, yielding incremental improvement in the composite target score.
design_principle: In multilayer dielectric stacks, once the gross layer sequence and approximate thicknesses are established, small adjustments (5-10 nm scale) can shift interference fringe positions within stopbands and passbands. Local exploitation search is appropriate when the topology is sound but fringe alignment needs refinement.
proposed_topology: 36-layer alternating stack: Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2/Ta2O5/SiO2 (air incidence, fused silica substrate)
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses with ±8 nm perturbation bounds around baseline values
optimizer step schedule favoring local exploitation
soft_objectives: maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm passband
minimize average transmittance in 355-365 nm stopband
minimize average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm stopband
manufacturing_considerations: all layer thicknesses must remain within 20-350 nm manufacturable range
thickness adjustments kept small to maintain process control
theory_basis: Recalled: Quarter-wave optical thickness for Ta2O5 at 355 nm is approximately 42 nm (n≈2.1), for SiO2 approximately 61 nm (n≈1.46)
Recalled: Dual-band stop filters require non-periodic thickness distributions to place stopbands at non-harmonic wavelengths
Recalled: Local thickness perturbations of 5-10 nm can shift interference fringes without changing overall stack behavior
Recalled: Gradient-based thickness optimization converges faster when initialized near a good solution with narrow bounds
expected_advantages: Preserves established interference structure while refining fringe positions
Reduced risk of jumping to unrelated local minima
Maintains manufacturability by keeping thickness changes small
known_risks: Ta2O5 is not in material_catalog.guaranteed_names; prior iterations suggest it resolves but this is not certain - if resolution fails, substitution with TiO2 would be needed
±8 nm bounds may be too restrictive if the baseline candidate is not near the true optimum for this topology
Recalled refractive index values for Ta2O5 and SiO2 at 355 nm and 1064 nm are approximate; actual dataset values may differ
Local exploitation may miss better solutions that require larger thickness changes
What would settle uncertainties: verify Ta2O5 dataset resolution in registry, check actual n/k values at target wavelengths
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer planar dielectric filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Stack topology is fixed as alternating Ta2O5 (Gao) and SiO2 (Gao) layers starting with Ta2O5 (Gao) (layer 1) and ending with SiO2 (Gao) (layer 36). Optimize individual layer thicknesses with bounds set to baseline value ±8 nm for each layer, where baseline values are: layer 1 Ta2O5 (Gao) 78 nm, layer 2 SiO2 (Gao) 94 nm, layer 3 Ta2O5 (Gao) 65 nm, layer 4 SiO2 (Gao) 116 nm, layer 5 Ta2O5 (Gao) 137 nm, layer 6 SiO2 (Gao) 104 nm, layer 7 Ta2O5 (Gao) 126 nm, layer 8 SiO2 (Gao) 94 nm, layer 9 Ta2O5 (Gao) 140 nm, layer 10 SiO2 (Gao) 100 nm, layer 11 Ta2O5 (Gao) 107 nm, layer 12 SiO2 (Gao) 105 nm, layer 13 Ta2O5 (Gao) 119 nm, layer 14 SiO2 (Gao) 100 nm, layer 15 Ta2O5 (Gao) 124 nm, layer 16 SiO2 (Gao) 104 nm, layer 17 Ta2O5 (Gao) 110 nm, layer 18 SiO2 (Gao) 102 nm, layer 19 Ta2O5 (Gao) 126 nm, layer 20 SiO2 (Gao) 101 nm, layer 21 Ta2O5 (Gao) 117 nm, layer 22 SiO2 (Gao) 107 nm, layer 23 Ta2O5 (Gao) 111 nm, layer 24 SiO2 (Gao) 105 nm, layer 25 Ta2O5 (Gao) 120 nm, layer 26 SiO2 (Gao) 105 nm, layer 27 Ta2O5 (Gao) 103 nm, layer 28 SiO2 (Gao) 103 nm, layer 29 Ta2O5 (Gao) 123 nm, layer 30 SiO2 (Gao) 101 nm, layer 31 Ta2O5 (Gao) 131 nm, layer 32 SiO2 (Gao) 100 nm, layer 33 Ta2O5 (Gao) 125 nm, layer 34 SiO2 (Gao) 97 nm, layer 35 Ta2O5 (Gao) 139 nm, layer 36 SiO2 (Gao) 99 nm. All thicknesses must remain within 20-350 nm absolute bounds. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with local exploitation step schedule. Target objectives: maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm band, minimize average transmittance in 355-365 nm band, minimize average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm band. Evaluate transmittance at 0 degree incidence, unpolarized.
